item.text:
The module exports four small order helpers from [test/orders.js](/abs/path/not/available). It computes an order total (`calcTotal`), applies percentage discount codes (`applyDiscount`), computes an average item price (`averageItemPrice`), and formats an order into a printable multi-line summary (`formatOrder`).

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` has an off-by-one loop bug at [test/orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js:5). It uses `i <= items.length`, so the last iteration reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, causing `items[i].price` to throw.
- `averageItemPrice` is logically wrong at [test/orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js:18). `calcTotal(items)` returns total order value (`price * qty`), then divides only by `items.length`, so it gives average per line item, not average per item unit. If one line has `qty > 1`, the result is inflated.
- `averageItemPrice` can also divide by zero for an empty `items` array at [test/orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js:19), returning `Infinity`/`NaN` instead of a defined result.

Residual risk:
- `formatOrder` depends on `calcTotal`, so the loop bug also breaks formatted orders for any non-empty input.
